input.summary: Remove the market-segment field-of-use limit on the customers Corio may serve
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the markets we may serve, so we have deleted the "Corio Market Segment" field-of-use limit from the definition of Customers (the North America Territory limit remains, with the expansion path in Section 2.10). Fallback: retain the revenue threshold but keep the existing growth/M&A carve-out and add a right to serve larger customers on notice to Commerce One.

ops.oldText: who obtains a sublicense from Corio to use the Software or MarketSite.net Service, in the Corio Market Segment.
